title: The Garage on Jalan Kusuma Atmaja Where Martha Tilaar Began
conflicts: First salon growth: APEC case says it filled almost the whole house within three months; detik says it moved to larger premises within six months; both given. Sariayu: company history and 2026 obituaries say 1977 (PT Martina Berto with Kalbe founders), while the APEC case and the 2008 Jakarta Post profile place Sari Ayu after a Mustika Ratu partnership ended (APEC: February 1979); story attributes 1977 to the company history. Father named Yakob Handana or Handana Tjie (not named in story). APEC mentions an earlier 1960s salon in her mother's house; story follows the company's 1970 start.
notes: She died on 14 October 2026 (Jakarta Post obituary), a fortnight before research. APEC case PDF loads but is compressed, so the checker marks it live without the name; read in full after decompression. Babysitting income and car figures (her own claims) not used.
